svg.title: BZ10J live chip. Die shot of BZ10J, the chip of Bartosz Zambrzycki, junior Fullstack developer. The path of a request runs through the frontend in Angular · TypeScript, the backend in C# · .NET and the storage in SQL · Object Storage (S3). Under it sit Linux, Git · CI/CD · Docker and Bash · Python. Requests move one stage per clock tick and the response returns to the browser along the top lane.

g.text: One request path, the tools under it
Angular, .NET and SQL sit on the path of a request, from the
browser to the data. Linux, my delivery pipeline and my
scripting languages sit under them. Every clock tick moves
each request one stage on, and the response returns to the
